description:
You are a university law library cataloger. Three landmark Supreme Court case references have been recently added to the Jurism library but are missing their Library of Congress KF classification call numbers. You need to assign the correct call numbers to each case so they can be integrated into the library's catalog system.

The Jurism library is already open and contains pre-loaded legal references. For each of the following three cases, locate the item in the library list, click on it to open its detail pane on the right side, find the 'Call Number' field in the Info tab, and enter the exact call number specified below:

1. Brown v. Board of Education → Call Number: KF4155 .B76 1954
2. Miranda v. Arizona → Call Number: KF9625 .M57 1966
3. Marbury v. Madison → Call Number: KF4541 .M37 1803

IMPORTANT: The call numbers must be entered exactly as shown above, including spacing and punctuation. After entering each call number, click on another item or press Tab to ensure the field value is saved (Jurism auto-saves on field blur).

All three cases should be visible in the 'My Library' view in the left panel. Scroll through the item list to find each case by its name.
